name: @tellescope/sdk
description: Code for interacting with the Tellescope API

scripts.test: npm run-script build:cjs && node ../../../scripts/dev/check-build-fresh.mjs && npm run-script retest
scripts.retest: npm run-script retest-api && npm run-script retest-public-api && npm run-script retest-webhooks
scripts.test-api: npm run-script build:cjs && node ../../../scripts/dev/check-build-fresh.mjs && npm run-script retest-api
scripts.test-public-api: npm run-script build:cjs && node ../../../scripts/dev/check-build-fresh.mjs && npm run-script retest-public-api
scripts.test-sockets: npm run-script build:cjs && node ../../../scripts/dev/check-build-fresh.mjs && npm run-script retest-sockets
scripts.test-webhooks: npm run-script build:cjs && node ../../../scripts/dev/check-build-fresh.mjs && npm run-script retest-webhooks
scripts.build: npm run-script build:esm && npm run-script build:cjs

author: Sebastian Coates
